doc: SABOTAGE: the naive < 80 ms same-column gap rule.
SABOTAGE: MERGE = 0.035 (the pre-2026 merge that deleted real 34 ms jacks).
SABOTAGE: every hold's release 50 ms later.
Suppress a tail cap on a hold under 0.25 s whose head the rail did not claim, lane occupancy >= 0.55 between them.

Suppress a short hold's tail cap when a loose lane bar (occupancy 0.25, 0.03 s) of 0.067-0.20 s opens within 20 ms of the head, which claimed no rail, and closes within 20 ms of the cap, and both notes correlate under 0.97 of the chart's median.
tailcap-b, and the pair scrolls at one speed (4%), the head correlates at 0.72-0.97 of the median and the cap under 0.92, 0.06-0.115 s apart.

tailcap-c with every guard held to the central 90% (5th-95th percentile) of what tailcap-c removed on the tune split: bar 5-7 frames, opening within 19 ms, closing within 12 ms, speeds within 2%, head at 0.78-0.945 and cap under 0.91 of the median, 0.065-0.100 s apart.

tailcap-d with the bar allowed to open up to 35 ms from the head (the caps tailcap-d left on the tune split that failed only its bar test opened a median 24 ms from the head, and closed within 8 ms of the cap).
